content.title: Launch of AKU-ISMC Student Engagement Scheme
content.summary: AKU-ISMC unveils its pioneering student engagement scheme, a unique initiative designed to inspire students to assume ambassadorial roles and explore numerous opportunities within their academic pursuits.

media.alt: Launch of AKU-ISMC Student Engagement Scheme

content.text: London, February 20, 2024 - The Aga Khan University's Institute for the Study of Muslim Civilisations (AKU-ISMC) marked a historic moment on February 20th with the official launch of its Student Ambassador Scheme. Hosted at the AKU-ISMC campus in London, the event unveiled an innovative initiative set to redefine student engagement by inspiring individuals to take on ambassadorial roles and explore diverse opportunities within their academic pursuits.

These ambassadors will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between students and faculty, advocating for student needs, and leading initiatives that contribute to the overall vibrancy of the campus.

Furthermore, the AKU-ISMC Student Ambassador Scheme provides students with a myriad of opportunities to engage in extracurricular activities, community service projects, and collaborative research efforts. By immersing themselves in these experiences, students have the chance to broaden their perspectives, develop new interests, and build lasting connections with their peers and mentors.

The launch event saw a high level of enthusiasm from attendees, it is poised to become a hallmark of the AKU-ISMC experience, shaping the next generation of leaders who will make meaningful contributions to their communities and beyond.
